I recently moved house, and was looking outside into my back garden earlier when I noticed something peculiar. There was a small congregation of birds in my garden, too many to just be a coincidence. At first, I thought I might become the victim of avian murder plot, but upon closer inspection I figured out why the birds had gathered.

There were 6 pieces of brown bread on the lawn. I watched as a fat pigeon stuffed his face and chased smaller birds away from his new found Hovis stash. I did not put this bread on the lawn, and at first I thought maybe the birds carried the bread over my fence into the garden, but 6 almost whole slices of bread? I think not.

It is clear that somebody has been throwing bread into my back garden. I do not know if the perpetrator has nefarious intentions at this time. However, I will be watching closely to try and get to the bottom of this conundrum.

I plan to scan the lawn for bread every 6 hours and mark down the times when new bread appears, to see if there is any correlation. Hopefully, if I can cancel the time between bread litterings down, I can catch the culprit red handed and confront them.

Note that this is not an isolated incident: I saw some brown bread on the green outside my house a couple of days ago.

I will keep you all posted as I'm sure you're as enthralled as I am and wish more than anything to know who hatched this dastardly scheme, and why they chose to smite me with the wrath of 1000 birds.
